items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Australian home, light and airy coastal Scandinavian style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, plain unbranded appliances with blank control panels, high detail. Palette: white, light oak, soft sage green, warm daylight. A small single-wall Australian laundry room about 1.6 metres wide, seen straight on at eye level: on the left a white front-loading washing machine with a round glass porthole door standing on the floor, with a white tumble dryer stacked directly on top of it on a stacking frame, the dryer has a plain solid white square-ish door with no glass window, so the two machines look clearly different; to the right a stainless steel laundry tub set into a slim white cabinet with a chrome mixer tap over the tub; a light oak open shelf above the tub with two woven baskets and folded towels; white wall tiles behind the tub, light grey floor tiles.
